{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nygann Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where [[Doune]] and [[Kinnin Vo-Shay]] had a second [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game. Vo-Shay willingly lost the second game to keep himself and [[Nyo]] alive, losing his ''lucky'' pendant in the process, a pendant which had served its purpose as a distraction to his opponents.<ref name="TLH">{{JournalCite|13|The Last Hand (short story)}}</ref>
